reason: A Claude Code Git workflow assistant focused on branch management, commit conventions, pull request preparation, code review guidance, conflict handling, and Git statistics.

summaries.zh: 用于辅助 Git 分支管理、规范化提交信息、拉取请求流程、冲突处理、代码审查和提交统计。
summaries.en: A Claude Code assistant for Git branch management, Conventional Commits messages, pull request workflows, conflict guidance, code review checks, and repository statistics.
